content.tex: INVESTIGATION SUMS OF NUMBERS
This investigation looks at the sum of the positive integers, \(1+2+3+\cdots\) .
It also looks at the sum of their cubes, \(1^{3} +2^{3} +3^{3} +\cdots\) .
